text:
Diane: FYI account 'EuropaHealth' (EH-908) just pinged support. They were promised a pilot promo code (PHASE1FREE) covering first-month usage but were billed €3,850 on invoice EH-2026-04-11. Customer asking for a full refund + confirmation the promo will be applied to next bill. Can finance approve a one-time credit?

Sam: I dug in — promo code exists but never attached to the customer account. Sales note from 2026-03-28: 'offer PHASE1FREE for pilot month, courtesy of SE'. No Deal Desk ticket.

Hiro: Policy: credits >€2k require Deal Desk + Finance lead. This is €3,850 so escalate. Need Sales Ops confirmation that promo was officially committed. Also want to know whether we should treat as marketing promo (GL 6505) or customer discount (GL 6510).

Diane: Support SR-7204 has the SE email chain. PS flags churn risk medium-high if we don't make them whole — they're evaluating a 6-mo purchase.

Nora: Sales Ops confirms SE verbally promised promo, but no written approval in CRM. They recommend honoring as a one-time customer acquisition concession. Suggest classify under 6505 (promotional credits).

Sam: Opening Deal Desk entry DD-2026-194 now with linked SR-7204 and email evidence. Tagging @Hiro for finance sign-off.

Hiro: Approve provisional credit amount €3,850 under GL 6505 (Promotional Credits). Require BillingBot to queue credit memo CM-EH-2026-04-77 and Sales Ops to document AE follow-up.

Diane: Draft customer note: "We've issued a one-time credit of €3,850 for your pilot month. The promo code PHASE1FREE will be applied to your account and future pilots will require explicit CRM documentation." Want me to send? :email:

Nora: Send after the credit posts. Also please capture a short CS handback: SE must log promo approvals in CRM going forward.

Sam: BillingBot, queue credit memo CM-EH-2026-04-77 for invoice EH-2026-04-11 amount=3850 reason='pilot promo not attached; honor SE commitment'. GL=6505 tag=pilot_promo.

BillingBot: queued credit memo CM-EH-2026-04-77 (amount: €3,850) for invoice EH-2026-04-11. Processing ETA: 24h. Reference: #CM-EH-2026-04-77.

Hiro: Noted. I'll update the month-close notes for April with contra-rev impact and flag DD-2026-194 as approved. SQL for audit: 
```\nSELECT invoice_id, currency, total_amount, applied_promos
FROM invoices
WHERE invoice_id = 'EH-2026-04-11';
```\nResult snippet: EH-2026-04-11, EUR, 3850, NULL

BillingBot: CM-EH-2026-04-77 posted to customer account at 2026-04-13T08:43:21Z.

Diane: Confirmed posting and notified the customer. Customer replied: 'Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.' PS will close SR-7204.

Sam: Closing DD-2026-194 in Deal Desk with GL 6505 and note: 'one-time promo honor; SE coaching required'.

Hiro: Finance closed. Marked as one-off promotional credit; no contract amendment. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
